analysis_scope: historical offline analysis and actual export of one real RGB/state observation

prompt.value: H0 historical observation diagnostics only; inspect the real RGB frame and measured Piper state. This is not a manipulation task label.
prompt.label_status: Explicit observation diagnostics prompt; not a demonstrated manipulation task label.

image_conversion: PNG decoded directly to RGB with Pillow; no BGR stage, resize or undistortion
limitations: One historical raw RGB frame and measured state establish the implemented offline data path only; no model inference or current hardware acceptance was performed.
The current implementation directly decodes PNG to RGB with Pillow; it has no BGR stage and applies no extra channel swap, resizing or undistortion.
The source window is historical wrist-camera data. It does not validate the current external-camera mounting, calibration or model input distribution.
Association compares same-boot monotonic receive timestamps, not camera exposure or hardware-synchronized timestamps.
The explicit diagnostic prompt is not a real manipulation task label, and no measured feedback is relabeled as an action.
Original nanosecond values are read from preserved source text with Python integers; exact timestamp strings here prevent consumer JavaScript number rounding.
Historical CSV/PNG and NPZ stay outside the pi repository; only this compact report and provenance are supplied for integration.
